title: AgentIdentity
description: Identity and trust contract for an agent participating in a Memory Bridge. Defines who an agent is, what it is authoritative over, and how much its writes and votes are weighted. The top-level contract is closed (additionalProperties: false) because it carries trust-bearing fields; forward-compatible, non-authoritative metadata belongs in the 'extensions' object, which is never consumed by trust or governance logic. v0.2 is a breaking change over v0.1: the contract is now closed and per-trust_class confidence_ceiling maxima are enforced in-schema.

id.description: Stable, unique identifier for the agent within a project. Lowercase, hyphen-separated by convention.

name.description: Human-readable display name for the agent.

trust_class.description: Precedence and confidence tier of the agent. Determines the confidence ceiling enforced on this agent's writes and its precedence when beliefs conflict. Precedence order: user > system > model agents.

domain_authorities.description: Domains in which this agent's beliefs are treated as authoritative. Used to rank relevance during retrieval and to resolve conflicts in favor of the domain owner.

confidence_ceiling.description: Maximum confidence this agent may assert on any single belief, regardless of the confidence value it submits. Writes above the ceiling are clamped. The per-trust_class maximum is enforced by the allOf rules below and must stay in sync with BASE_CONFIDENCE_CEILING in integrations/conflict-resolution/types.ts. A record may declare a LOWER ceiling than its class maximum, but never a higher one.

quorum_weight.description: Voting weight of this agent in Parliament governance decisions. A proposal passes when the sum of YES weights meets the configured quorum threshold. Note: there is no per-class maximum enforced on quorum_weight; consumers must not treat a record-declared weight as authoritative without out-of-band registration.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this identity was registered.

registered_by.description: Identifier of the principal (typically a human operator) who registered this agent.

registered_skills.description: Optional. Named skills or operations this agent is registered to perform.

notes.description: Optional. Free-text operator notes about the agent's role or constraints.

extensions.description: Optional. Forward-compatibility escape hatch for non-authoritative metadata. Trust and governance logic MUST NOT read from this object. Unknown future fields belong here, not at the top level, so that schema validity continues to imply trust-contract integrity.
